messages:
Alex R: Quick primer for the exec ask tomorrow — I pulled the tradeoffs into one thread. Need a clear (+) / (-) on three commitments by EOD so we can shape the slide.
Priya S: ack. which three exactly?
Alex R: 1) Harden Hosted API SLA to 99.95% with a 200ms 95th latency target for small requests (chat single-turn). 2) Commit to a Dedicated capacity minimum (N GPUs reserved) for top customers, includes burst buffer. 3) Ship Private deploy baseline (VPC) with telemetry on by default for support (opt-out).
Marco L: I want to call out capacity + cost risk on (2). Reserving N GPUs locks cost — we need forecast confidence or a buffer for model upgrades. +1 on SLA if we add a mitigation plan.
Lin W: For (1) latency target: 200ms 95th is doable on smaller context lengths if we accept narrower model set (quantized variants). If we keep all model variants we blow the tail latency.
Casey: engineering input: to hit 200ms for chat we need: batching thresholds tightened, priority routing for premium customers, and KV cache on critical prefixes. That implies ~2 weeks infra change + canary.
Priya S: For (3) telemetry by default: legal flagged this for regulated customers. Private baseline should be telemetry off for regulated tenants, telemetry opt-in with an easy toggle. Support needs some heartbeats for debugging though.
Alex R: Noted — so modified ask: telemetry on by default for non-regulated, opt-in for regulated. We still want support heartbeats (anonymized) unless customer opts out entirely.
Marco L: +1 to the modified ask if we add an audit trail for telemetry toggles and a clear docs section. Also need to state config migration impact for existing Private customers.
Sam K: high level from exec: we need product commitment sizes and rollback plan. I can sign off if engineering gives a clear rollback policy and cost envelope for Dedicated.
Casey: rollback policy sketch: feature-flag routes, split by customer tier; instant throttle to hosted fallback; Dedicated: gradual scale-back with traffic draining (48h). Cost envelope: +/- 15% from baseline for 90% confidence.
Priya S: OKR alignment check: these reads map to Q3 P0: "Inference reliability & predictable economics" — targets: reduce outage minutes by 60%, per-token cost down 15% through batching & quantization/route policy.
Alex R: I'll add a bullet: "Canary plan + rollback + cost envelope" to the slide. Need a single line approvals from each of you by 5pm so I can take to the exec deck.
Marco L: +1 conditional on adding the model-variant restriction note for SLA (we document which models qualify).
Lin W: +1 but call out that the 200ms target only applies to requests <= 512 tokens and prioritized routing; non-priority can be higher.
Casey: +1, engineering will deliver rollback runbook in the canary PR. I'll paste the runbook link in the deck tomorrow.
Priya S: +1 for telemetry change + docs update, but product commit: add milestone for legal sign-off before release to regulated accounts.
Alex R: Great — collecting: Marco(+1 w/ model list), Lin(+1 w/ token limit), Casey(+1 w/ runbook), Priya(+1 w/ legal gate). Sam, that's everything you need to sign off?
Sam K: This is good. I approve the ask for tomorrow's exec review. Condition: slide must show the canary timeline, rollback steps, cost envelope, and which models count for SLA. I'll be on the call.
ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 23:00-01:00 UTC — avoid canary start during window.
Alex R: Thanks everyone. I'll update the slides and ping when done. If anything changes, react in-thread. :thumbsup:
